content: If you suspect an overdose, contact a poison control center immediately. Residents of the United States can call 1-800-222-1222 for assistance. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current medical condition and should not be used for other purposes unless directed by your healthcare provider. While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as cultures or liver and kidney function tests) may be required to monitor your progress and check for side effects. It is important to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here was last revised in August 2024. Please note that this is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most up-to-date information.
